name: frameleaf-manager
extra_parameters: --label app.frameleaf.manager.role=controller --security-opt no-new-privileges --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER
description: Install and manage a self-hosted Frameleaf photo and video library. Manager coordinates sibling services through the Docker socket. Encrypted recovery covers the database and configuration, not media originals. Before applying, create the storage folders and follow the linked setup guide for the storage mappings. Create the administrator from your home network on first open.

paths.name: Manager state
paths.description: Persistent sessions and recovery configuration. When changing the host path, change the container path and MANAGER_DATA too.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Original media. Keep host and container paths identical and update MANAGER_STORAGE_ROOTS.

paths.name: Database parent
paths.description: Physical host storage outside Docker data/docker.img. Keep host and container paths identical and update database root variables.

paths.name: Database backups
paths.description: Encrypted database-only checkpoints. Keep host and container paths identical and update MANAGER_BACKUP_ROOT.

paths.name: Docker socket
paths.description: Allows Manager to create and control sibling containers on this host.

paths.name: Host mount information
paths.description: Read-only host filesystem evidence for database storage checks.

paths.name: Unraid Docker configuration
paths.description: Read-only Unraid appdata and Docker storage configuration.

paths.name: Unraid autostart file
paths.description: Required for imports: select the existing unraid-autostart file beneath the exact DockerRootDir reported by docker info. Do not create a replacement or guess a pool path.

ports.name: Manager HTTPS port
ports.description: Port you open Manager on. 2282 sits next to Frameleaf (2283) and avoids 9443, which Portainer and other apps often use

variables.name: Manager HTTPS origin
variables.description: Optional. Leave blank to open Manager by IP address or tower.local. Only for a custom DNS name, enter that exact HTTPS address with port (for example https://nas.example.com:2282) and set Advanced View WebUI to match.

variables.name: State path
variables.description: Must equal both paths in the Manager state mapping above.

variables.name: Media roots
variables.description: Approved media folders, separated by colons. Each needs an identical host/container mapping.

variables.name: Database roots
variables.description: Approved database parent folders, separated by colons. Each needs an identical host/container mapping.

variables.name: Database default
variables.description: Default database parent. Must be one of the mapped database roots above.

variables.name: Backup path
variables.description: Must equal both paths in the Database backups mapping above. Does not back up media.

variables.name: Frameleaf address
variables.description: Where the Frameleaf app it installs is published. 0.0.0.0 makes it reachable from other devices on your network; 127.0.0.1 limits it to this server.

variables.name: Platform
variables.description: Unraid host integration; keep this value.

variables.name: Autostart controller path
variables.description: Leave blank unless the autostart file above is mounted. For an import, set this to /run/frameleaf-host/unraid-autostart after selecting that existing host file.
